review.notes: Independent package review against the accepted plan (16 nodes, 26 API items, 16 definition tests, 7 named acceptance checks). All six criteria hold after small in-place corrections. (1) Upstream form: Summary, scope, conventions, supplier contracts, six layers with Examples and Dependencies, consumers and references; no process language. (2) Fidelity: all 65 plan names are in the README; the 16 theorem/definition statements match the plan's hypotheses and conclusions; the 12 targets and 4 HP.1 milestones are Lean declarations. (3) Sources: both PDFs match the packet SHA-256; 14 Delange locators (pp. 213-214, 220-224, 226-229, 231, 233, 235-237, 239, 242) and Wood section 7, pp. 415-417 were checked against the printed pages; all correct. (4) Duplication: current Tau Ceti a91d3aaf proves only the simple-pole Wiener-Ikehara theorems and Laplace transforms of measures at real arguments; no TauCetiRoadmap roadmap, Mathlib 6b7abb3 or open Mathlib PR 40582 contains a higher-pole theorem, the squared-sinc kernel or the Delange weight; nothing removed. (5) lean-check at Mathlib 082e2d3 / Tau Ceti f790474 exits 0 with 31 warnings, all sorry, no errors; 369 lines, four real-bodied light definitions, one proved instance, no sorry'd data. (6) metadata.toml is topic = "math.NT". Corrections: added API PoleBoundary.mul and delangeWeight_shift_uniform (the uniform shift HP.3.1 uses); added negative controls for a = 0 in HP.4.3 and for Re s > 0 in HP.4.1; scoped the abscissa convention; fixed the zeta-power example to m >= 1; clarified the quadratic Laplace check; recorded the current Tau Ceti path of the summatory module; made the Gamburd-Magee-Ronan consumer note precise. Adversarial pass table in the report. Port note: at Tau Ceti a91d3aaf the import TauCeti.Order.Northcott is TauCeti.Order.Northcott.Basic.
